subject: how to adjust the lines to match the points on the graph?

messages.author: 7181df0c34cdcd0f
messages.subject: how to adjust the lines to match the points on the graph?
parts:
Hi guys, 

I am plotting a line graph but the lines and points do not match each other. Does anyone know how to adjust them?

Here are the codes:

data <- read.xls('time_vs_conc.data.xlsx',sheet = 1, header =T)
p <- ggplot(data,aes(x=time,y=viability,color=concentration, shape = method))
p + geom_point(size=6, position=position_dodge(.4)) + 
  geom_line (aes(group=interaction(concentration, method), linetype=concentration), position=position_dodge(.4))+
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(y = 'viability (%)') + 
  theme (axis.title.x = element_text(size=25), axis.title.y =element_text(size =25), axis.text.x = element_text(size=20), axis.text.y =element_text(size =20), 
         legend.text = element_text(size =15), legend.title = element_text(size=15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, max(data$viability)),breaks=0:7*15)

The data and the final graph were also attached!

Thanks for your help in advance!

Zongtai

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: how to adjust the lines to match the points on the graph?
parts:
Hi,

you're using position_dodge; the exact position of the glyphs is randomized around their original position, and in a different way for both layers. I believe you'd be better off doing this jittering of the positions manually (e.g. with ddply) on the whole dataset before plotting.

HTH,

b.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: how to adjust the lines to match the points on the graph?
parts:
I think what Baptiste meant is that you should randomly jitter the points yourself before plotting, instead of depending on position_jitter. Here's a toy example:

d <- data.frame(x=c(1,2),y=c(3,4))
qplot(x,y,data=d,position="jitter",geom=c("point","line"))  # line and points don't match up
d$xjit <- d$x + runif(nrow(d))-.5  # make our own jittered points
d$yjit <- d$y + runif(nrow(d))-.5
qplot(xjit,yjit,data=d,geom=c("point","line"))  # they match

Ben
